question: Which of the following elements was the last element of the Mendeleev's periodic table?
solution:
Option **3** is correct, i.e. __**Uranium.**__

__
 
• **Mendeleev's Periodic Table:**__

 __
 
• **Uranium was the last element of the Mendeleev's periodic table.**
 
• There were 63 elements in his periodic table. 
 
• He arranged elements according to Atomic mass.
 
• He developed it in the year 1869.
 
 

Note:

 
• Modern Periodic Table:__

 
 
• The Modern Periodic Table is classified into the following elements - p-block, s-block, d-block, and f-block.
 
• The p-block elements include chalcogens, pnictogens, halogens, inert gases.
 
 
• The 18th group is known as Inert gas, zero groups, Nonreactive gases.
 
• The 17th group is known as Halogen.
 
• The 16th group is known as Chalcogen.
 
• The 15th group known as Pnictogen.
 
 
 
• The s-block elements include alkali metals and alkaline earth metals. 
 
• The d-block elements include Transition elements.
 
• The f-block elements include Inner Transition Elements.
